analysis:
Examined all supplied patch and BASE excerpts of ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift. HEAD adds an add-on hold fence before taking the load gate (397), another after hashing (577), and hold-aware interruption checks during setup and immediately before slot installation (711, 945). Existing shutdown/cancellation behavior remains prioritized by modelLoadInterruption (1044–1047), and the changed branches retain newcomer release and ordered bridge unwind. These changes strengthen A-018/TB-012/T-059 availability isolation; no independently supported security regression was identified. Weight verification, cache identity publication and SSD eligibility checks relevant to T-012/T-027/T-041 remain unchanged in the supplied scope. No changed encryption, credential, attestation or billing behavior is visible.
Integration must verify addonHoldLoadRefusal and hold acknowledgement/drain semantics: the post-hash fence still precedes an awaited budget recheck (BASE 576), and native Super/MiMo paths return before the generic post-hash/publication checks (BASE 502–511). Their hold handling is outside this evidence, not an observed missing control. Also verify persistLoadedModelSet: HEAD 1203 now calls it during add-on unloads, relying on that helper rather than the former caller exclusion to preserve the restart serving set. This is a material cross-file contract requiring reconciliation with the hold lifecycle and startup preload changes; the supplied scope does not establish a persistence regression.
